progress.firstDownload: The first download takes a while — later VMs from this image are ready in seconds.

unassigned.conversation: The chat uses its agent's VM again, if it has one.
unassigned.agent: The agent uses its workspace's VM again, if there is one — otherwise it works on this Mac.
unassigned.workspace: Its agents work on this Mac again, unless they have a VM of their own.

toast.suspendedDescription: Its memory is saved to disk — Resume continues right where it left off.
toast.startingFirstScreen: Its screen opens as soon as macOS is up.
toast.startingFirstTerminal: Terminal opens as soon as macOS is up.
toast.savedLater: CPU, memory and display apply the next time the VM starts.
toast.resetDescription: A clean macOS from its image. The shared folder and assignments were kept.
toast.duplicatedDescription: Same disk contents, its own shared folder. Assign it to an agent or workspace.
toast.deletedKeep: Its shared folder is still at {{path}}
toast.assignedDescription: The VM starts when a run needs it.

picker.title: Virtual machine
picker.description: Runs in this chat browse, run commands and use apps inside this macOS VM instead of on your Mac.
picker.defaultMacHint: The agent and its workspace have no VM
picker.fieldEmpty: No virtual machines yet — create one to give agents their own Mac.

panel.suspendedHint: Suspended — resumes with the next message
panel.offHint: Off — starts with the next message
panel.screenUnavailable: The screen isn't available right now
panel.insideTitle: The agent works inside this VM
panel.hostShellOff: Nothing opens on your Mac — no browser, no apps, no shell.
panel.hostShellOn: No browser or apps open on your Mac.

card.resetTooltip: Recreate it from its image — the shared folder is kept
card.openScreenAria: Open the screen of {{name}} in Screen Sharing

hint.folder: Open in Finder — the VM sees it as {{path}}
hint.availableWhenReady: Available when the VM is ready
hint.showScreen: Show its screen in Screen Sharing
hint.startsThenScreen: Starts the VM, then shows its screen
hint.startsThenTerminal: Starts the VM, then opens Terminal

card.assignAria: Assign {{name}} to an agent or workspace
card.everyAgent: Every agent in it, unless it has its own
card.singleChatHint: For a single chat, pick the VM with the VM button in its message box.
card.runsAs: Runs in the VM as <mono>{{user}}</mono> — stops after 2 minutes. Agents use the same shell.

new.title: New virtual machine
new.description: A clean macOS on this Mac for your agents to work in — isolated from your files and apps. It keeps its disk until you reset or delete it.
new.diskHint: At least {{n}} GB for this image. Disks can only grow later.
new.host: This Mac: {{cpus}} cores, {{memory}} memory. Changes to CPU, memory and display apply on the VM's next start.
new.startWhenReadyHint: Boot macOS as soon as the VM is created, so it's warm when an agent needs it.
new.freeUnknown: Free space on this Mac is unknown.
new.tightDownload: The download ({{download}} GB) and the VM's disk (up to {{disk}} GB) may not fit — free up space or pick a smaller disk.
new.tightDisk: The VM's disk (up to {{disk}} GB) may not fit — free up space or pick a smaller disk.
new.free: {{n}} GB free on this Mac. The VM's disk only takes up the space macOS actually uses.
new.readyBooting: It's ready and booting in a moment.
new.downloading: Downloading {{image}} ({{size}} GB) — keep working, progress shows on its card.

edit.title: Edit “{{name}}”
edit.suspended: It's suspended with its current hardware. Shut it down (⋯ → Shut down) to change CPU, memory, display or disk.
edit.bootsLater: CPU, memory and display changes apply the next time the VM starts.
edit.later: Changes apply the next time the VM starts.
edit.diskStop: Stop the VM to grow its disk.

reset.title: Reset “{{name}}”?
reset.body: Its disk is erased and recreated from {{image}} — apps, files and settings inside the VM are gone.
reset.kept: The shared folder ({{folder}} in the VM) and who uses the VM are kept.
reset.startAgain: Start it again when it's ready

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.creating: Creating it stops and the VM is removed from this Mac.
delete.removed: The VM and its disk are removed from this Mac. This can't be undone.
delete.removedSize: The VM and its disk ({{size}}) are removed from this Mac. This can't be undone.
delete.oneUser: {{name}} goes back to working on this Mac, unless it has another VM.
delete.oneUserFallback: The agent, chat or workspace using it goes back to working on this Mac, unless it has another VM.
delete.manyUsers: The {{n}} agents, chats and workspaces using it go back to working on this Mac, unless they have another VM.

page.title: Virtual machines
page.description: Isolated macOS machines on this Mac — agents work there instead of on your computer.
page.turnedOffTitle: Agents don't use VMs right now.
page.turnedOffBody: Virtual machines are turned off in <link>Settings → Virtual machines</link> — every run works on this Mac. You can still manage VMs here.
page.emptyTitle: Give an agent its own Mac
page.emptyDescription: It installs tools, runs builds and uses apps in an isolated macOS VM instead of your computer. Assign a VM to an agent, a chat or a workspace.
page.runningTooltip: Apple lets one Mac run at most {{max}} macOS VMs at the same time. Stop or suspend one to start another.
page.unsupportedReason: macOS VMs need a Mac with Apple silicon.
page.unsupportedKeep: Agents keep working on this computer as usual.
page.setupBody: Godmode runs macOS VMs with Apple's Virtualization framework (via <link>Tart</link>, free for personal use). VMs and their disks are stored on this Mac in <mono>{{path}}</mono>.
page.setupSkip: Creating a VM sets this up too — you can skip straight to New VM.
